name: Indus Finance Limited
about: Indus Finance Limited provides lending and financial services as a non-banking financial company in India. The company invests in and offers loans to the wind and solar; infrastructure and property development; and agriculture and food processing sectors. It also provides loans against shares; mortgage loans on properties; and individual loans. The company was formerly known as Indus Finance Corporation Limited and changed its name to Indus Finance Limited in January 2015. Indus Finance Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
